/**
 * @covers \WPMedia\BackWPup\Tracking\Tracking::track_start_job
 *
 * @group Tracking
 */
class TrackStartJobTest extends TestCase {

	public function set_up(): void {
		parent::set_up();
		\BackWPup::set_is_pro( true );
	}

	public function tear_down(): void {
		\BackWPup::set_is_pro( false );
		delete_site_option( 'backwpup_license_email' );
		parent::tear_down();
	}

	/**
	 * @dataProvider configTestData
	 */
	public function testShouldDoAsExpected( array $config, array $expected ): void {
        $was_pro = \BackWPup::is_pro();
        if ( isset( $config['is_pro'] ) ) {
            \BackWPup::set_is_pro( $config['is_pro'] );
        }
        
		$user_id = self::factory()->user->create( [ 'user_email' => $config['email'] ] );
		wp_set_current_user( $user_id );

		if ( isset( $config['backwpup_license_email'] ) && '' !== $config['backwpup_license_email'] ) {
			update_site_option( 'backwpup_license_email', $config['backwpup_license_email'] );
		}

		$optin          = $this->createMock( Optin::class );
		$mixpanel       = $this->createMock( MixpanelTracking::class );
		$option_adapter = $this->createMock( OptionAdapter::class );

		$tracking = new Tracking( $optin, $mixpanel, $option_adapter );

		if ( ! $expected['status'] ) {
			$optin->expects( $this->once() )
				->method( 'can_track' )
				->willReturn( false );

			$tracking->track_start_job( $config['job_data'], $config['backup_trigger'] );

			return;
		}

		$optin->expects( $this->once() )
			->method( 'can_track' )
			->willReturn( true );

		$mixpanel->expects( $this->once() )
			->method( 'identify' )
			->with( $config['email'] );

		$option_adapter->method( 'defaults_job' )
			->willReturn( $config['defaults_job'] );

		$mixpanel->expects( $this->once() )
			->method( 'track' )
			->with( 'Scheduled Backup Job Started', $expected['job_data'], 'bwu_mixpanel_send_event' );

		$tracking->track_start_job( $config['job_data'], $config['backup_trigger'] );
        
        if ( isset( $config['is_pro'] ) ) {
            \BackWPup::set_is_pro( $was_pro );
        }
	}
}
